The '''Supercopa do Brasil''' ({{IPA|pt-BR|su.peɾˈkɔ.pɐ du bɾaˈziw}}, {{langx|en|Brazil's Super Cup}}), officially named '''Supercopa Rei''' since 2024 ({{IPA|pt-BR|su.peɾˈkɔ.pɐ ˈʁej}}, {{langx|en|King Super Cup}}), is a Brazilian [[football (soccer)|association football]] trophy organized by the [[Brazilian Football Confederation]] (CBF). It is contested between the champions of the [[Campeonato Brasileiro Série A|Campeonato Brasileiro]] and the winners of the [[Copa do Brasil]]. If the same club wins Campeonato Brasileiro and Copa do Brasil, their opponent will be the Campeonato Brasileiro runner-up.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://conteudo.cbf.com.br/cdn/201912/20191217172333_304.pdf |title=Regulamento Específico da Competição Supercopa do Brasil 2020 |publisher=Confederação Brasileira de Futebol Diretoria de Competições |language=pt |page=Parágrafo único, Art. 2º, page 4 |access-date=26 February 2020 |archive-date=26 February 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200226063154/https://conteudo.cbf.com.br/cdn/201912/20191217172333_304.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref>

The Brazilian Football Confederation announced in 2013 a new edition of the competition was expected to be played in 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.lancenet.com.br/minuto/CBF-Supercopa-Brasil-definir-detalhes_0_1024697607.html|work=[[Lance!]]|title=CBF dá como certa a Supercopa do Brasil em 2015; falta definir detalhes|date=6 November 2013|access-date=18 November 2013|language=pt|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131118205144/http://www.lancenet.com.br/minuto/CBF-Supercopa-Brasil-definir-detalhes_0_1024697607.html|archive-date=18 November 2013}}</ref> The revival would only take place in 2020. In honor of ''O Rei'' [[Pelé]], who died in 2022, the Supercopa do Brasil was renamed the Supercopa Rei on 31 January 2024.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.cbf.com.br/futebol-brasileiro/noticias/supercopa-masculino/cbf-homenageia-pele-e-competicao-passa-a-se-chamar-supercopa-rei |title=Supercopa Rei: competição muda de nome em homenagem a Pelé |publisher=CBF |date=31 January 2024 |language=Portuguese}}</ref>

== Unofficial competitions ==
===1992===
{{Main articles|Taça Brahma dos Campeões}}
An unofficial competition was played in 1992, between the champions of the [[Campeonato Brasileiro Série A|Série A]] and of the [[Campeonato Brasileiro Série B|Série B]], as both championships were played in the first six months of the year. The game was played on 12 August between [[Clube de Regatas do Flamengo|Flamengo]] (champion of the Série A) and [[Paraná Clube|Paraná]] (champion of the Série B). The game ended in a 2–2 draw, and in the [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shootout]], Flamengo beat the opponent 4–3. While [[RSSSF]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Supercopa do Brasil|website=[[RSSSF]]|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesb/brazsupcuphist.html|access-date=18 November 2013|archive-date=13 July 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220713135952/https://www.rsssf.org/tablesb/brazsupcuphist.html|url-status=live}}</ref>  regards the competition as some form of Supercopa do Brasil, although officially not regards as Supercopa do Brasil, in Brazil the competition was popularly known as [[Taça Brahma dos Campeões]]. Differently from the 1990 and 1991 editions, which were official CBF competitions,<ref>{{cite news|title=Supercopa do Brasil|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?nid=0qX8s2k1IRwC&dat=19910127&printsec=frontpage&hl=en|newspaper=Jornal do Brasil|date=27 January 1991|page=first section, page 28|language=pt}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Supercopa do Brasil|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?nid=0qX8s2k1IRwC&dat=19910128&printsec=frontpage&hl=en|newspaper=Jornal do Brasil|date=28 January 1991|page=first section, page 16|language=pt}}</ref> the 1992 edition<ref>{{cite web|title=Super Cup Finals|url=http://www.rsssfbrasil.com/tablesrz/supercup.htm#92|publisher=RSSSF|access-date=18 November 2013|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121123233323/http://www.rsssfbrasil.com/tablesrz/supercup.htm#92|archive-date=23 November 2012}}</ref> was a friendly cup.<ref>{{cite news|title=Supercopa do Brasil|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?nid=0qX8s2k1IRwC&dat=19920811&printsec=frontpage&hl=pt-BR|newspaper=Jornal do Brasil|date=August 12–14, 1992|pages=19 (JB News Archive page 86) and page 16 (JB News Archive page 220)|language=pt}}</ref>

===2018===
In 2018, Corinthians, champion of [[2017 Campeonato Brasileiro Série A]] and Cruzeiro, champion of [[2017 Copa do Brasil]], played two friendly matches during the period corresponding to the [[2018 FIFA World Cup]] to determine the unofficial Super Cup winner. The first game, played at Mineirão on July 4 ended with a 2–0 win for Corinthians,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://globoesporte.globo.com/mg/futebol/jogo/04-07-2018/cruzeiro-corinthians.ghtml|title=Cruzeiro 0 x 2 Corinthians - Amistosos Amistosos - Tempo Real - Globo Esporte|access-date=3 January 2020|archive-date=14 February 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220214235220/https://ge.globo.com/mg/futebol/jogo/04-07-2018/cruzeiro-corinthians.ghtml|url-status=live}}</ref> while the return game, played on July 11 at the Arena Corinthians, ended in a 2–2 draw.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://globoesporte.globo.com/sp/futebol/jogo/11-07-2018/corinthians-cruzeiro.ghtml|title=Corinthians 2 x 2 Cruzeiro - Amistosos Amistosos - Tempo Real - Globo Esporte|access-date=3 January 2020|archive-date=12 February 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220212095816/https://ge.globo.com/sp/futebol/jogo/11-07-2018/corinthians-cruzeiro.ghtml|url-status=live}}</ref> Two years later, the competition officially returned.
